title: Classical flute teachers and her percussive jazz flute style
summary: She made up her own jazz flute style, percussive, listening to Harold McNair, Jeremy Steig and Frank Wess.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Yeah. Okay. So you’re on your way to become a musician and —

And I had classical flute teachers. I sort of made up my own style of jazz on flute. I knew what I wanted and I found it. It was a very percussive style for a long time, and I listened to sort of Harold McNair, Jeremy Steig, Frank Wess, just everybody I could get my hands on.
